name: X-Men
note: Introduces the returning Fox X-Men: Xavier, Magneto, Cyclops, Mystique.

name: X2: X-Men United
note: Nightcrawler's debut. Cyclops leads the X-Men in the final trailer.

name: X-Men: The Last Stand
note: Kelsey Grammer's Beast. Ends the original X-Men trilogy.

name: Captain America: The First Avenger
note: Steve and Peggy. The Doomsday trailer opens on Steve, Peggy and their son.

name: The Avengers
note: Loki, Thor and the team's origin.

name: X-Men: Days of Future Past
note: Fox X-Men timeline reset. Bridges both X-Men generations.

name: Captain America: Civil War
note: The Avengers split. Bucky, Black Panther and Ant-Man join the story.

name: Avengers: Infinity War
note: Stay for the post-credits scene.

name: Avengers: Endgame (Encore)
note: Watch the Encore cut (on Disney+ since Nov 13, 2026). Its new end-credit scenes lead into Doomsday: Loki visits Steve and Peggy, and Doom forges his mask.

name: WandaVision
note: Wanda's arc. Sets up the Scarlet Witch tease in VisionQuest.

name: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
note: Sam becomes Captain America. Bucky's arc.

name: Black Widow
note: Yelena and Red Guardian. Sets up Thunderbolts*.

name: Loki
note: Full order: watch Season 1 here and Season 2 after Wakanda Forever and Quantumania. Speedrun: Season 2 is the must-watch. The TVA, the multiverse and Loki as its keeper.

name: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
note: Shang-Chi is confirmed for Doomsday and appears in the trailer.

name: Hawkeye
note: Kate Bishop (Hailee Steinfeld) appears in the final Doomsday trailer.

name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
note: Multiverse bleed between universes.

name: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
note: Incursions, the Illuminati, Patrick Stewart's Xavier and the Scarlet Witch.

name: Thor: Love and Thunder
note: Thor is confirmed. His daughter Love fits the trailer's montage of heroes with their children.

name: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
note: Shuri as Black Panther, and Talokan. Both appear in the trailer.

name: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
note: Scott and his daughter Cassie, who both appear in the trailer. Kang setup. Watch Loki Season 2 after this.

name: The Marvels
note: Multiverse tear and an X-Men tease (Beast).

name: Deadpool & Wolverine
note: The Void, Fox-verse heroes and Channing Tatum's Gambit.

name: Captain America: Brave New World
note: Sam as Captain America, and the state of the Avengers.

name: Thunderbolts*
note: The New Avengers who go into Doomsday. Stay for the post-credits scene.

name: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
note: The Earth-828 Fantastic Four. The credits scenes set up Doom.

name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
note: The last MCU film before Doomsday. One Endgame Encore scene shows Doom holding Hulk after its events.

name: VisionQuest
note: Speedrun: just watch Episode 8 and its post-credits scene, where Doom confronts the Scarlet Witch.
